# API coverage

<!-- GENERATED by spec/tools/Get-FogApiCoverage.ps1. Do not edit. -->

FOG 1.6.0-beta.3820 serves **545 operations** across **51 route classes**. This is what FogApi offers for each of them.

Generated from `spec/fog-api-spec.json`, which is itself built from FOG's own OpenAPI document. Rebuild with `spec/tools/Build-FogApiSpec.ps1` then this script.

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `x` | A typed cmdlet exists today. |
| `o` | A typed cmdlet is specified and will be generated. |
| `f` | Folded: a parameter on another cmdlet rather than a cmdlet of its own. |
| `d` | Deferred: the operation is understood but deliberately not modelled yet. See `folded` in the spec for why. |
| `-` | Reachable only through the generic L1 wrappers. |
| (blank) | The server does not serve this operation for this class. |

**Totals:** 25 covered, 212 specified, 153 folded, 51 deferred, 83 L1-only.

## Fixed routes

Endpoints with no class shape, so no L1 representation. These are the only cmdlets allowed to call `Invoke-FogApi` directly.

| Operation | Method | Path | Cmdlet | State | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bandwidth` | GET | `/bandwidth/{dev}` | `Get-FogBandwidth` | specified |  |
| `export` | GET | `/system/export` | `Export-FogDatabase` | specified |  |
| `initrdUpdate` | GET | `/availableinitrds` | `Get-FogAvailableInitrds` | specified |  |
| `kernelUpdate` | GET | `/availablekernels` | `Get-FogAvailableKernels` | specified |  |
| `logfiles` | GET | `/logfiles/{id}` | `Get-FogServerLog` | covered | was `Get-FogLog`. Get-FogLog reads a LOCAL log file. This route reads the server's. |
| `openapi` | GET | `/system/openapi` | `Get-FogApiSpec` | specified | Unauthenticated. The runtime half of this whole effort. |
| `pendingmacs` | GET | `/pendingmacs` | `Get-FogPendingMacs` | covered | was `Get-FogHostPendingMacs`. Existing function is host-scoped; this route is server-wide. |
| `settingsCacheFlush` | POST | `/settings/cache/flush` | `Clear-FogSettingsCache` | specified |  |
| `settingsCacheRefresh` | POST | `/settings/cache/refresh` | `Update-FogSettingsCache` | specified |  |
| `settingsCacheView` | GET | `/settings/cache` | `Get-FogSettingsCache` | specified |  |
| `snapinCreateWithFile` | POST | `/snapin/createwithfile` | `New-FogSnapinWithFile` | covered | was `New-FogSnapin`. |
| `status` | GET | `/system/info` | `Get-FogSystemInfo` | covered | was `Get-FogVersion`. Also serves /system/status; same handler, same payload. Carries version AND the paging bounds, which is what makes it the cheap probe. |
| `unisearch` | GET | `/unisearch/{item}` | `Find-FogAll` | specified | -Limit is per entity type, not a total, and there is no nextUrl. Must not reuse -First. |
| `uploadSnapinFiles` | POST | `/storagegroup/{id}/uploadsnapinfiles` | `Send-FogSnapinFiles` | specified |  |
| `whoami` | GET | `/whoami` | `Get-FogCurrentUser` | specified |  |

## FOG 1.5

No spec exists for the 1.5 line: it ships no `commons/schema-expected.php`, so nothing describes its types. The deltas below are hand-recorded in `spec/overlay/fog-api-overlay.json` and are what every generated cmdlet branches on.

- **Envelope:** {count, <classname>s[]} rather than 1.6's DataTables-style envelope. Add-FogResultData already normalises this.
- **Paging:** None. No limit(), no complex(), no MAX_ROWS, no paginate. The query string is ignored and lists are unbounded, so the pager collapses to one request.
- **Operations 1.5 does not have:** `count`, `join`, `names`, `ids`, `active`, `unisearch`, `whoami`, `logfiles`, `pendingmacs`, `settingsCacheView`, `settingsCacheFlush`, `settingsCacheRefresh`, `kernelUpdate`, `initrdUpdate`, `bandwidth`, `openapi`
- **Classes 1.5 does not have:** `filedeletequeue`, `role`, `rolepermission`, `roleuserassociation`, `roleusergroupassociation`, `usergroup`, `usergroupmember`, `hookevent`, `notifyevent`, `keysequence`, `nodefailure`
